header: THE PAX ADMIN OPERATIONS (step 64a; my request, 31 Oct 2026): add, modify, delete a line; authorise and revoke an executive; read the history. Every operation
- runs in ONE transaction, under one lock, so two people cannot add the same number at the same moment,
- checks the person's authority INSIDE the transaction (the HOD of C&IT by SUPERADMIN_TICKETS, or an executive the HOD has authorised and not revoked),
- writes its audit line in the same transaction, so a change cannot be saved without the record of who made it (ticket and name from the login) and the line before and after.

I reach the database through a tiny interface (PaxDb), so the same code runs against the application's connection and against a scratch database in the tests. SECURITY: like pax_directory, the tables here are closed to the public API roles. Only the application's own connection touches them, never the language model's read-only client.

symbols.name: loadLine
symbols.sig: function loadLine(q: QueryFn, id: number)
doc: I LOCK the line's row BEFORE it is read for a change or a delete. Any writer that does not know the global lock (a SQL script) must then wait until this transaction ends, and the version check sees what that writer did. Locks one PAX line and reads all the lines, because the clash checks need them. This is the guard's `load`; it gives null when the line is not there.

symbols.name: DEPARTMENT_CHOICE
symbols.sig: const DEPARTMENT_CHOICE = "Choose the department from the list."
doc: THE DEPARTMENTS TO CHOOSE FROM (my rule, 23 Nov 2026): the department of a PAX line is CHOSEN from the plant's departments (public.sail_department, the register the employee directory uses: about three hundred names), never typed. The list is every distinct department name as the rest of the app shows it (formatDepartmentDisplay), A to Z. The server holds the rule, so a typed or altered name is refused; the form is only a convenience. A name that differs from a listed one only in capitals or spaces takes the listed spelling. A line saved before this rule keeps its own department when only its number is changed, so the department is left as it is.
